stage: Stage 2 only — Heart UX and Liked Tracks persistence
rootCauses: Heart used generic selected IconButton styling, adding a circular background rather than a dedicated morphing glyph.
Collection changes were published only after durable save, delaying feedback on every surface.
Adding likes required the track to be present in the bounded metadata registry, rejecting valid stable catalog IDs after eviction.
implemented: Single native animated SVG heart path, 220 ms fill/unfill and bounded 1.08 scale; cancellation on replacement/unmount and reduced-motion support; no circular overlay.
One shared account-scoped LikeButton on song rows and Player, with synchronized morphing heart in track actions.
Immediate shared-state presentation over durable account data; explicit idempotent setLiked intent, failed-save rollback and latest-intent protection for rapid toggles.
Account generation captured before notifying subscribers; stale rendered callbacks and late account results cannot mutate the next account.
Existing alternating journals and existing authenticated cloud synchronization reused; no authentication bypass or persistence-schema change.
Library headings retained; repetitive descriptions, eyebrows and counts removed. Liked Tracks keeps useful errors and unavailable-song feedback.

coverage: Rapid toggles without duplicate IDs or intermediate flicker
In-flight failures and synchronous account switching
Production account-journal offline/restart/synchronization with injected remote fake
Shared control accessibility and stale callback guards
Morph geometry, bounded scheduling, interruption cleanup and reduced motion

limits: All storage and remote synchronization tests use isolated in-memory storage and injected remote test doubles. No live account/database writes were executed.
Animation tests verify geometry, element structure and scheduling with a mocked React Native/UI runtime; native smoothness is unverified.
No updated APK was built or installed. Actual Android Heart interaction, visual acceptance, restart and account-switch persistence remain pending.
